arxiv-1812-08061.creator: Estefania Vidal-Henriquez, Azam Gholami
arxiv-1812-08061.description: Abstract Dictyostelium discoideum ( D.d. ) is a widely studied amoeba due to its capabilities of development, survival, and self-organization. arxiv-2206-02939.title: A Centraliser Analogue to the Farahat-Higman Algebra
arxiv-2206-02939.creator: Samuel Creedon
arxiv-2206-02939.description: Abstract . We define a family of algebras 𝖥𝖧 m \mathsf{FH}_{m} which generalise the Farahat-Higman algebra introduced in [ FH59 ] by replacing the role of the center of the group algebra of the symmetric groups with centraliser algebras of symmetric groups. These algebras have a basis indexed by marked cycle shapes, combinatorial objects which generalise proper integer partitions.

arxiv-2301-11410.title: Automatic differentiation as an effective tool in Electrical Impedance Tomography
arxiv-2301-11410.creator: Ivan Pombo, Luis Sarmento
arxiv-2301-11410.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Ivan Pombo, Luis Sarmento. Determining physical properties inside an object without access to direct measurements of target regions can be formulated as a specific type of inverse problem . One of such problems is applied in Electrical Impedance Tomography (EIT). In general, EIT can be posed as a minimization problem and solved by iterative methods, which require knowledge of derivatives of the objective function. In practice, this can be challenging because analytical closed-form solutions for them are hard to derive and implement efficiently.

arxiv-2407-04592.description: Abstract 1 Introduction Traditionally, emotions have played only a marginal role in historical research and heritage discourse. During the twentieth century, various disciplinary turns and paradigm shifts, specifically the emergence of sensory studies [ 1 ] and the history of emotions [ 2 ] , have broadened the perspective of humanities-based research beyond the scope of classical historiography.

arxiv-2507-12309.creator: Shahryar Ghaed Sharaf
arxiv-2507-12309.description: Abstract . He was the grandson of Thomas Marryat (physician, author of The Philosophy of Masons, and writer of verse), and son of Joseph Marryat, agent for the island of Grenada, who wrote pamphlets in defence of the Slave Trade. His mother was a Bostonian of German extraction.

pmc-13485267.title: The Prognostic and Diagnostic Role of Atrial Strain in Cardiomyopathies: A Literature Review
pmc-13485267.creator: Beatrice Dal Passo, Renè Tezze, Federica Frascaro, Sofia Meossi, Carmen Izzo, Laura Rotondo, Giorgio Sciaramenti, Edoardo Menzato, Elisabetta Tonet, Federico Marchini, Matteo Serenelli, Anna Cantone, Gianluca Campo, Rita Pavasini
pmc-13485267.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Atrial strain assessment, both by speckle-tracking echocardiography and feature tracking cardiac magnetic resonance (CMR), represents a useful tool in all the spectrum of cardiomyopathies. The most robust evidence available in the literature concerns cardiomyopathies with a hypertrophic phenotype, in which left atrial strain (LAS) has demonstrated to be able to differentiate each phenotype, with cardiac amyloidosis (CA) having the lowest LAS values compared to hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM), Fabry cardiomyopathy (FD), and hypertensive heart disease.
